measurements.description: Readings attached to this alert episode, oldest first.
measurements.title: Measurements

low.description: Edit the proposed range before approving (basis becomes 'doctor').
low.title: Low

BandOut.description: A personal ring range. The model proposes; only the assigned doctor activates (approve) or rejects.

limitations.default: Experimental, not clinically validated. Never an alert and never patient guidance; visible only to the assigned doctor while the screen is open (no notification).
limitations.title: Limitations

BandOut.title: BandOut

bp_capability.description: What the device can tell about blood pressure. A ring or watch is 'none': its samples are never blood-pressure readings.
bp_capability.title: Bp Capability

is_simulated.description: True for simulator devices (device_type 'simulator'). Label them as such.
is_simulated.title: Is Simulated

confirmed.description: Always false. An action is what the patient tapped or opened (an attempt). PULSE has no call, SMS or dispatch integration: it never knows that a call connected, a message was sent or delivered, or help was dispatched.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

age.description: Approximate age in years (current year - birth_year, may be 1 year high). Null when the patient has not entered a birth year, or before migration M5 (patient_profiles.birth_year) is applied.
age.title: Age

client_fallback.description: Used by the frontend ONLY when the API cannot be reached.

id.description: Generated by the client so retries are idempotent.
id.title: Id

EmergencyEventOut.description: An incident record: the emergency screen was opened. It does not mean anyone was called or notified.
EmergencyEventOut.title: EmergencyEventOut

number.description: Null = not configured (demo mode without PULSE_DEMO_NUMBER, dev only): disable the call button and show a configuration warning.
number.title: Number

verified.description: False until the team has confirmed the number (decision D3).
verified.title: Verified

readings.description: Readings from started_at - 24 h to started_at + 24 h.
readings.title: Readings

EvaluationOut.description:
Deterministic rule result, always returned in the same response as the reading or symptom report.

Reading flagged invalid by the database: level="none", rule_id="DATA-INVALID", no alert, next_step asks
to measure again; if the reading is outside the plausibility limits (systolic > 300 or diastolic > 200, or
systolic < 50 or diastolic < 25: too low to be real, or a failed cuff) requires_symptom_check is true so a typo
never hides a possible crisis.

level.description: none | low (below 90/60, R-LOW-1/2) | notice (above target) | trend | severe (>= 180 or >= 120) | emergency (red-flag symptom).
level.title: Level

recheck_after_seconds.description: If set and no red-flag symptom: show a timer, then ask for a new reading.
recheck_after_seconds.title: Recheck After Seconds

requires_symptom_check.description: Show the symptom checklist now and POST symptom-reports.
requires_symptom_check.title: Requires Symptom Check

rule_id.description: Rule that decided the level: R-EMG-1, R-SEV-1/2/3, R-LOW-1/2, R-TGT-1, R-TRD-1, or DATA-INVALID.
rule_id.title: Rule Id

EvaluationOut.title: EvaluationOut

alerts.description: Alerts created or updated by fresh, measured rows.
alerts.title: Alerts

by_status.description: Validation of the inserted rows by the database (policy pulse-v1).

duplicates.description: Rows already stored with the same label (same values within 2 minutes, pulse equal or missing), or repeated in the file: skipped.
duplicates.title: Duplicates

evaluation.description: Highest-level rule result among fresh measured rows (ties: the latest); requires_symptom_check is true if any fresh row needs it. Drive the symptom check and recheck from it exactly as for a manual reading.

historical.description: Inserted rows measured more than 10 minutes ago, or before the patient's latest stored reading: history only, no alert.
historical.title: Historical

past_severe.description: Historical measured rows at or above 180/120; next_step then asks for a reading now.
past_severe.title: Past Severe

simulated_preview.description: What the rules would have decided for fresh simulated rows. No alert was created.
simulated_preview.title: Simulated Preview

source.description: Show 'simulated' readings as simulated, never as a real measurement.
source.title: Source

MeasurementIn.description:
Bounds below are the database storage limits only (CHECK constraints), so impossible input gets
one consistent 422. Plausibility (e.g. systolic > 300 = invalid) is decided by the database policy
pulse-v1 after the reading is stored, and reported in measurement.validation_status.

id.description: Optional, generated by the client so retries are safe. Sending the same id again returns the stored reading with status 200 and never changes alerts, also when both requests arrive at once. The same id with different values, or an id already used by another patient, is 409 conflict.
id.title: Id

measured_at.description: Defaults to server time when omitted.
measured_at.title: Measured At

measured_tz.description: IANA zone where the reading was taken; defaults to the profile time zone.
measured_tz.title: Measured Tz

MeasurementIn.title: MeasurementIn

validation_status.description: Computed by the database (policy pulse-v1); never sent by clients.
validation_status.title: Validation Status

alert.description: Alert created, attached to, or raised by this reading.

NoteOut.description: Assigned doctors see every note. The patient sees only notes with advice or a follow-up date, with note=null.

note.description: Private clinical note; null when the reader is the patient.
note.title: Note

NoteOut.title: NoteOut

age.description: Approximate age in years (current year - birth_year, may be 1 year high). Null when the patient has not entered a birth year, or before migration M5 (patient_profiles.birth_year) is applied.
age.title: Age

PredictionOut.description:
Latest row of ml_predictions for the configured model version, written by the offline batch job.
model_unavailable: no row, or the newest row targets a day before the patient's local today (stale).

limitations.default: Experimental model estimate trained on synthetic data only. Not a measurement, not clinically validated, never used for alerts or emergency guidance.
limitations.title: Limitations

PredictionOut.title: PredictionOut

ProfileIn.description:
PUT replaces the whole profile: every field is required (send null or [] to clear a value), so a
partial form can never silently erase allergies, conditions or location consent.

birth_year.description: Year only (data minimisation). Stored by migration M5; the API also rejects years after the current year.
birth_year.title: Birth Year

medication_context.description: As entered by the patient; PULSE never interprets it.
medication_context.title: Medication Context

ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn

ReadingsImportIn.description:
A cuff export sent as CSV text (no multipart upload). Columns: measured_at, systolic, diastolic required;
pulse, unit (mmHg only), position, arm, note optional; lines starting with '#' are comments.

Rows measured within the last 10 minutes and after the patient's latest stored reading go through the same rules
as a manual reading, oldest first; other rows are history only. A row already stored with the same label (same
values within 2 minutes, pulse equal or missing) is a duplicate. Rows declared simulated never create an alert:
the rules' result is returned as a preview.

provenance.description: What the file really contains. A file whose first comment line starts with '# SIMULATED' or '# SYNTHETIC' must be 'simulated'. 'simulated' is accepted only when the server runs in demo mode.
provenance.title: Provenance

tz.description: IANA zone for timestamps without an offset; defaults to the profile time zone.
tz.title: Tz

ReadingsImportIn.title: ReadingsImportIn

row.description: Line number in the file (comments and the header count).
row.title: Row

RingImportIn.description:
A ring / bracelet export as CSV text. Columns: measured_at, metric (heart_rate, hrv_rmssd, spo2,
skin_temperature), value required; unit, external_id optional. Ring data never reaches the rules (D18).

source.description: 'csv_import' for a real device export, 'simulated' for generated data (demo mode only). A file whose first comment line starts with '# SIMULATED' or '# SYNTHETIC' must be 'simulated'.
source.title: Source

tz.description: IANA zone for timestamps without an offset; defaults to the profile time zone.
tz.title: Tz

RingImportIn.title: RingImportIn

SummaryOut.description:
Descriptive statistics over the patient's own readings. Every statistic here (count_7d, averages, maximum,
pct_above_target_7d, days_with_reading_7d, trend) uses VALID readings of any provenance, so simulated demo
readings are included; count_7d_* says how many of them are measured, simulated or estimated. None of this
drives alerts: the clinical trend alert (R-TRD-1) ignores simulated readings.

count_7d.description: Valid readings in the last 7 days, any provenance. needs_review and invalid readings are not counted here.
count_7d.title: Count 7D

count_7d_estimated.description: Of count_7d: provenance 'estimated' (e.g. a wearable estimate, never a cuff reading). Under validation policy pulse-v1 every estimated reading is needs_review, so this is 0 until that policy changes; such readings appear in count_needs_review_7d.
count_7d_estimated.title: Count 7D Estimated

count_7d_measured.description: Of count_7d: provenance 'measured' (cuff or manual entry).
count_7d_measured.title: Count 7D Measured

count_needs_review_7d.description: needs_review readings of the last 7 days, any provenance. Excluded from count_7d, its provenance split and every statistic.
count_needs_review_7d.title: Count Needs Review 7D

pct_above_target_7d.description: Share of the valid 7-day readings above target, simulated ones included.
pct_above_target_7d.title: Pct Above Target 7D

trend.description: 7-day vs previous 7-day mean of valid readings, simulated ones included. Descriptive only.
trend.title: Trend

SummaryOut.title: SummaryOut

measurement_id.description: The reading that led to this check. Must be one of the patient's readings (else 422); not stored until migration M7 adds the column.
measurement_id.title: Measurement Id

measurement_id.description: Always null until migration M7 stores the link.
measurement_id.title: Measurement Id

report.description: Always stored, including an empty 'none of these' answer (migration M3, live).

note.description: Required to resolve a severe or emergency alert.
note.title: Note

contact_consented.description: The patient confirms the contact agreed to be listed.
contact_consented.title: Contact Consented

TrustedContactPatch.description:
A different phone number may be a different person who never consented: changing `phone` is refused
(422 consent_required); delete the contact and add the new number with contact_consented=true.
TrustedContactPatch.title: TrustedContactPatch

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to display times, e.g. Africa/Algiers.
timezone.title: Timezone

WearableFlagOut.description:
A ring flag written by the offline monitor. kind 'early_warning' (window_kind 'forecast') is the live-v1
engine: value = forecast in 20 min, score = probability the limit is crossed within 20 min.

limitations.default: Experimental, not clinically validated. Never an alert and never patient guidance; visible only to the assigned doctor while the screen is open (no notification).
limitations.title: Limitations

WearableFlagOut.title: WearableFlagOut

WearableSampleOut.description:
Optional, additional data. A patient without a wearable has a complete record without it. Heart rate,
HRV, SpO2 and skin temperature are not blood-pressure readings, and no sample is ever an input to the
safety rules, alerts or emergency guidance.

source.description: 'simulated' samples are generated demo data and must be labelled.
source.title: Source

WearableSampleOut.title: WearableSampleOut

WeeklyReportOut.description:
Weekly report written by the offline job. summary: bp_home, ring, optional pulse_vs_population; mbp_estimate
only when it comes from the served BP model and targets today or later (else null).

limitations.default: Experimental, not clinically validated. Never an alert and never patient guidance; visible only to the assigned doctor while the screen is open (no notification).
limitations.title: Limitations

WeeklyReportOut.title: WeeklyReportOut
